Errors in PCIe and NVMe analyzer exports

A protocol analyzer records what passes between a host and a drive. It can export that in five CSV files, from single packets up to whole commands. This page lists every error those files can show: what happened, which rows prove it, and how sure we are.

All data checks on this page use synthetic recordings (made by the project's own generator). A check shows the application detects a pattern. It does not show that real drives produce it.

    When the five files do not fit together

    The errors above are faults of the drive or the link. These are faults of the recording itself: rows that do not follow the rules for combining the five files, and files that cannot be read at all.

    Rows that do not follow a joining rule

    A row that breaks a rule is never dropped. It stays in the tree, marked, and is counted. The admin sees each rule's count and example rows on page 2 of the flow. Above 5% of the rows a rule counts as not followed, and the tree cannot be accepted without the admin's written reason. The 5% is a project setting (agentic.join_break_limit_percent), not a number from a specification.

    RuleFileIfThen
    Packets into link transactionspackets.csv, link.csvA packet with a TLP Type finds no row with the same Link Dir and PSN within the next 256 rows of link.csvThe packet stays in the tree with no parent, and is counted.
    Packets into link transactionspackets.csvAn Ack or Nak names a PSN (in AckNak Seq Num) that no open link transaction holdsIt becomes a context packet, and is counted.
    Packets into link transactionslink.csvThe packets joined to a row differ from its Metrics.# PacketsThe row keeps what it got, and is counted.
    Link transactions into split transactionslink.csv, split.csvA request needing an answer finds no row of split.csv with the same Link Dir, RequesterID and TagIt is marked as outside and stays in the tree, counted.
    Link transactions into split transactionslink.csvA completion finds no open split going the other way with the same RequesterID and TagIt is marked as outside and stays in the tree, counted.
    Link transactions into split transactionssplit.csvThe link transactions joined differ from Metrics.# LinkTransThe split keeps what it got, and is counted.
    Link and split transactions into NVMe transactionsNVME_Transactions.csvThe units joined to a row differ from its Metrics.# Link & Split TransThe row keeps what it found, and is counted.
    Link and split transactions into NVMe transactionslink.csv, split.csvA posted write or split row is taken by no NVMe transactionIt is marked as outside and stays in the tree, counted.
    NVMe transactions into NVMe commandsNVME_Transactions.csvA row matches no command (SQID and CID, the doorbell, or the completion queue slot)It is marked as outside and stays in the tree, counted.
    NVMe transactions into NVMe commandsnvme_command.csvThe rows joined differ from Metrics.# NVME TransThe command keeps what it got, and is counted.
    Other packets attached to a command as contextpackets.csvA flow-control packet, ordered set or link event falls outside every command's time windowIt stays in the tree with no command. This is normal while the link is idle, so it is shown for information and never stops the tree.

    Files that cannot be used, and machines that run out

    IfThen
    A folder holding more than one file of the same kind, for example two packets filesRefused when the analysis is created, and again before the tree is built. The reason names the files. One folder holds one recording.
    A folder in which no CSV file is one of the five kindsRefused, with the reason. A CSV file of another kind beside a recording is listed and does not stop it.
    A path that is a folder, a pipe, a device or a link to nowhereRefused when the load is started, with the reason.
    The free disk is less than 4 times the size of the CSV filesRefused when the load is started, with how much is needed and how much is free. Measured: the finished database took 3.1 times the CSV size on a 3.4 GB recording and 1.9 times on a 7.9 GB one.
    Less than 1 GB of memory is freeRefused when the load is started.
    A file has a line longer than 64 MB, or no line ends at allRefused with the line number, without reading the file into memory.
    A cell never ends, usually because of a stray opening quoteRefused near that line when the cell passes 64 MB. A smaller damaged part ends up as fewer rows, which the rules above report.
    A file has 0 bytes, or none of the columns of its levelThat file is not used and the reason is recorded; the other files go on. If no file can be used, the load stops with the reason.
    A column that a rule reads is missing from the filesThe strategy review says which one. Approving needs a written reason.
    Memory falls below 300 MB, or the disk below 1 GB, during a loadThe load stops by itself with the reason. What was finished is kept and Load again continues from there.
    The operating system kills a worker process that reads a fileThe load stops with the reason, instead of waiting for ever. Load again continues.
    A file is deleted or cannot be read during a loadThe load stops and names the file.
    The database of a recording is damagedThe load stops and says to load the files as a new recording.

    How these were checked. Each row above was attacked with damaged copies of the synthetic recordings (tests/test_join_rules.py, tests/attack_round6.py, tests/test_limits.py), and a 19.7 GB recording was loaded with the memory held to 4 GB. They were not seen on a real capture.
